No Surprises

Your monthly costs, explained

We quote rates personally, but here is exactly how it works.

  • Included: free wifi, swimming pool, wardrobe and mattress
  • Paid separately: electricity, water, fitness room
  • Deposit: a refundable damage deposit is required, plus a 500 THB key deposit
  • Payment: cash or bank transfer
  • Minimum stay: 1 month
  • Pets: not allowed
Moving In

Moving in, step by step

  1. Message us on LINE, Facebook Messenger, WhatsApp or email with your move-in date and length of stay.
  2. Get your quote. We reply with current rates and availability.
  3. See your room. Visit in person, or we'll send photos by chat or email.
  4. Pay your deposit by cash or bank transfer.
  5. Move in. Your key is ready.

Good to Know

Long-stay questions

What is the minimum stay?

One month.

Can I extend my stay?

Yes. Just let us know at least one month before your contract ends, subject to availability.

What is included in the rent?

Free wifi, swimming pool access, wardrobe and mattress. Electricity, water and the fitness room are paid separately.

How much is the deposit?

A refundable damage deposit is required, plus a 500 THB key deposit. Message us for the amount for your room. Payment is by cash or bank transfer.

Can I see the room before I book?

Yes. Visit in person, or if you are booking from abroad we will send photos by LINE, Facebook Messenger, WhatsApp or email.

Is it quiet enough to work from home?

Yes. The rooms are quiet and have free wifi, well suited to working from home.

Do you speak English?

Yes. We reply in English and Thai.

Ready to make Hua Hin home?
